describe.description: The creature is a single four-legged equine shown in strict right-facing profile against a plain off-white background. Its body is covered in short brown fur that is darker along the back, neck and outer legs and paler on the muzzle, underbelly and inner legs. It has a long narrow head with a white muzzle, a short upright bristly mane along the neck, two large upright ears, a barrel-shaped torso, four slender legs ending in hooves, and a thin tail with a dark tuft at the tip. It is standing with all four feet on the ground in a naturalistic, detailed illustration style.
